originalFailure.failedStep: Verify the public updater endpoint without credentials
originalFailure.explanation: The publishing runner received the exact previous 0.53.0 manifest with HTTP 200 and a growing cache Age in all 24 attempts. The release itself was published successfully. A separate unchanged read-only workflow later obtained the exact 0.54.0 manifest. The original failure and skipped checks remain recorded; they are not converted to success.

downloads.diagnosis: verify_local_assets required dist/verified-release.json; the existing signed verification receipt was stored under signed. No HTTP download verification was attempted.

The unchanged CLI passed local verification, then the public APK URL returned HTTP 503 with zero bytes; the checksum URL returned HTTP 200 with the expected bytes. One bounded retry after at least 30 seconds; no URL/header/verifier changes.

scope: Successful preflight, exact-source persistent signing and publication; the original workflow failed its public endpoint check. Separate unchanged read-only workflow, unchanged local CLI checks and five independent anonymous GET checks subsequently verified the published release. Physical Android acceptance was not performed.
